placements.title: The derive-id path guarantees a valid slug even when no id field exists
placements.theme: When a heading carries no id field, the derive-id path must never crash and must always produce a valid slug.
placements.why: src-1 sets up the missing-id reproduction condition (## heading, no id field) mirroring a known prod failure, and src-2 states the required guarantee under that exact condition: no crash, valid slug produced. Together they describe a durable requirement on the derive-id fallback path — a subject future envelopes about slug generation, id derivation, or heading parsing will keep feeding — not a one-time fact. No existing narrative leaves or strata exist yet in this repo to hold this theme, so it is foundational: nothing close enough to relate it to via lineage, and no hub or strata category to nest it under.
